Container.Name: gbrain-aio
Container.Overview:
Vanilla GBrain all-in-one for Unraid. One s6 container runs PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector, the official GBrain HTTP server, a Caddy TLS reverse proxy, and the GBrain job supervisor. Postgres listens on loopback only and is never published. Agents connect only through the MCP endpoint, never to Postgres.
First run: 1. Set POSTGRES_PASSWORD and GBRAIN_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN to alphanumeric values. 2. Set GBRAIN_LAN_BIND and GBRAIN_PUBLIC_URL to your LAN HTTPS origin. 3. Create an empty brain directory matching BRAIN_PATH / SOURCE_NAME. 4. Start the container, then open https://<lan>:3132/admin/ and paste the bootstrap token. 5. Trust the generated CA once (caddy/certs/ca.pem) on any phone or WebView.
Advanced users can point OLLAMA_BASE_URL at a local Ollama for embeddings and openai-compat chat.

Config.Name: Brain Path
Config.Description: Host path to the brain markdown repo. Must be a git repo.

Config.Name: LAN Bind
Config.Description: LAN IP the container binds for HTTPS.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Public HTTPS origin clients use. Must match LAN Bind + port.

Config.Name: Source Name
Config.Description: Mounted brain source name. Must equal basename(BRAIN_PATH).

Config.Name: Brain UID
Config.Description: UID for the brain bind mount. Unraid default 99:100.

Config.Name: Brain GID
Config.Description: GID for the brain bind mount. Unraid default 99:100.

Config.Name: Ollama API Key
Config.Description: Ollama API key. ollama is the local default.
